blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Team Philippines continues its bid for its first gold medal at the Asian Games 2026 on Wednesday, September 23, in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. The Filipino gymnasts shoot for a medal in the men’s team final, the men’s and women’s 3×3 basketball teams try to clinch quarterfinals berths, while other athletes open their campaigns in esports, rowing, weightlifting and squash. Source: Asian Games website. Information subject to change.
